mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC of FEDFUNDS on 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or correlation is not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction signal (HOUST and INDPRO changes) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances where both series rise (change > 0.5%), or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.0%) trigger monetary tightening expectations that increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1800 units signal housing market contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in >60% of instances where HOUST < 1800, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and employment (PAYEMS) signals strong economic activity with rising corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction signal (INDPRO and PAYEMS changes) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >60% of instances where both series rise (change > 0.5%), or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Labor market tightening (UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS > 133000) accelerates wage pressures and inflation expectations, triggering monetary tightening that causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in >60% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS > 133000, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong economic activity and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Correlation between INDPRO (as continuous variable) and 5-day S&P 500 returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC is below 0.03.
